description: Implementation of a GLX Pbuffer surface for EGL in the ANGLE project, managing creation, resizing, and lifecycle of Pbuffers on the Raspberry Pi 4 platform.

classes.name: PbufferSurfaceGLX
classes.description: A class representing a GLX Pbuffer surface for EGL, handling creation, resizing, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: PbufferSurfaceGLX
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Pbuffer surface with specified parameters.

methods.name: ~PbufferSurfaceGLX
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the Pbuffer if it exists.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Pbuffer, creating it with specified attributes and handling size adjustments.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-buffer (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the Pbuffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the Pbuffer.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Checks if post sub-buffer is supported (unimplemented).

methods.name: getSwapBehavior
methods.description: Returns the swap behavior of the surface.

methods.name: checkForResize
methods.description: Checks for resize events (always returns success).

methods.name: getDrawable
methods.description: Returns the drawable handle for the Pbuffer.
